items.summary_en: A free 3-hour live virtual workshop from PESI, presented by ART developer Laney Rosenzweig, lead trainer Amy Shuman and researcher Dr. Kevin Kip. It introduces Accelerated Resolution Therapy (ART): its foundational concepts, the neuroscience of emotional memory and memory reconsolidation, the proposed role of eye movements, and the clinical populations for which ART may be appropriate. ART reprocesses painful memories so the emotional charge fades without requiring detailed retellings. Held Monday 21 December 2026, 09:00-12:15 Central Time (23:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 21 December to 02:15 on 22 December), fully online, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Free replay access for 3 days; up to 3 CE hours available for a $49.99 upgrade. brief_zh: 204 名 18–65 歲邊緣型人格障礙（BPD）門診病人，荷蘭 9 間中心，隨機分入辯證行為治療（DBT，n=95）或基模治療（ST，n=109）
兩種治療各為期 2 年，結合小組與個別形式；評估由不知分組的評估員進行
主要結果為 DSM-5 BPD 嚴重程度（BPDSI-5），由基線到治療後 1 年追蹤（基線起計 3 年）
36 個月追蹤時，兩組 BPDSI-5 平均差 −1.09（Cohen d=0.15，95% CI −0.17 至 0.47），組間無顯著差異（p=0.27）
次要結果（症狀嚴重度、功能、生活質素、幸福感、睡眠、脫落率）亦無組間差異，兩組皆大幅改善
脫落率：1 年時 DBT 34%、ST 29%；2 年時 DBT 52%、ST 46%
items.caution: 優越性試驗設計，未能證明兩種治療等效；脫落率高（2 年約五成）；荷蘭門診樣本，女性佔 84.3%；作者指需進一步研究邊種治療對邊種個案最有效。

posts.title: JAMA Psychiatry 論文（DOI: 10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2026.0418）

items.summary_en: Published online 22 April 2026 in JAMA Psychiatry. The BOOTS multicentre randomised clinical trial compared dialectical behavior therapy (DBT) with schema therapy (ST) in 204 adults aged 18-65 with borderline personality disorder across 9 Dutch outpatient centres (DBT n=95, ST n=109). Both treatments ran for 2 years in a combined group-individual format, with blinded assessment. At 36-month follow-up there was no significant difference between treatments in reducing BPD severity (BPDSI-5 mean difference -1.09, Cohen d=0.15, 95% CI -0.17 to 0.47; P=.27), and no differences on any secondary outcome, with large improvements in both treatments. Dropout was high in both arms (52% for DBT and 46% for ST at 2 years).
items.summary_zh: JAMA Psychiatry 2026-04-22 線上刊出。BOOTS 多中心隨機對照試驗比較辯證行為治療（DBT）與基模治療（ST）對邊緣型人格障礙（BPD）的效果，204 名 18–65 歲門診病人來自荷蘭 9 間中心（DBT n=95，ST n=109），兩種治療各為期 2 年，結合小組與個別形式，評估員不知分組。36 個月追蹤時，兩組在 BPD 嚴重程度（BPDSI-5）上無顯著差異（平均差 −1.09，Cohen d=0.15，95% CI −0.17 至 0.47；p=0.27），次要結果亦無組間差異，兩組皆大幅改善。脫落率高，2 年時 DBT 52%、ST 46%。

brief_zh: 108 名自殺行為障礙（SBD）患者的家屬照顧者，西班牙 11 間精神健康服務招募，隨機分入 Family Connections（FC）組或單次心理教育組，完成研究者 75 人
FC：12 節每週 2 小時網上小組，為期 3 個月，六大模組包括自殺心理教育、情緒覺察、人際效能、效能行為、徹底接納與解難；對照組：單次 3 小時心理教育小組
主要結果：兩組的主客觀照顧負擔都顯著下降，組間無差異；FC 組的主觀負擔效應量較大（d=0.58，對照組 d=0.27）
FC 組的家庭賦權升幅顯著大於對照組（F=13.19，p<0.001，d=0.42），壓力與效能行為亦顯著優於對照組
患者自傷頻率：FC 組照顧者回報顯著下降（p=0.04），對照組無顯著變化；自殺嘗試頻率兩組都下降，但組間無差異
items.caution: 無追蹤期，效果維持未知；完成樣本僅 75 人，統計效力有限；自傷與自殺嘗試頻率由照顧者回報，未必準確；FC 24 小時對照組只 3 小時，劑量差異大，組間差異未必全因 DBT 成分；西班牙樣本，量表未經西班牙語家屬樣本驗證。

ethics_flags.note: 照顧者本身是自殺風險較高群體，介入時需同時評估照顧者的自殺風險與支援網絡，不能只教技巧。

posts.title: Borderline Personality Disorder and Emotion Dysregulation 論文（DOI: 10.1186/s40479-026-00353-3）

items.summary_en: Published 13 June 2026 in Borderline Personality Disorder and Emotion Dysregulation. A randomised controlled trial tested Family Connections (FC), a DBT-based skills training programme, against a single-session psychoeducational intervention in 108 family caregivers of patients with suicidal behavior disorder, recruited across 11 mental health services in Spain (75 completed). FC comprised 12 weekly two-hour online group sessions over three months. Both conditions significantly reduced objective and subjective caregiver burden, with no between-group difference. FC produced significantly greater gains in family empowerment (F=13.19, p<.001, d=0.42), stress reduction and validating behaviours. Patients' non-suicidal self-injury frequency fell significantly in the FC condition only, as reported by caregivers.

items.summary_en: Published online 17 November 2026 in Psychotherapy Research (Vol 36, No 8). A randomised controlled pilot trial compared cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) with emotion-focused therapy (EFT) for depression in a Norwegian routine-care short-term programme: 111 clients randomised (CBT n=55, EFT n=56) to 9-18 individual sessions (mean about 13.5). Both groups improved substantially on the BDI-II from pre to post-treatment (CBT d=1.06, EFT d=0.84), with no significant between-group differences, and gains held at 12-month follow-up. About 50% in each group achieved reliable change; clinically significant change was 40% for CBT and 30% for EFT (not significant). Dropout was low (CBT 10.9%, EFT 1.8%).

items.summary_en: The Florida Center Training Institute's free introductory webinar takes place on Tuesday 15 December 2026, 12:00-1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (about 1:00-2:00 a.m. Hong Kong time on 16 December), presented by Christie L. M. Petrenko, PhD, clinical psychologist and Senior Research Director of Developmental & Behavioral Pediatrics at the University of Rochester Medical Center: 'FASD-Informed Care: Striving for Equity'. The session covers what fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASD) are, how a diagnosis helps, and what FASD-informed care looks like, and introduces the FMF Connect Pro app. Attendance is free and carries 1 free CEU for psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors. It is aimed at professionals working with children aged 3-13 with FASD or prenatal alcohol exposure.
